name: Rock skip
summary: A two-minute stone skipping game on a lake drawn from the side: pull the stone back and let go, power and a flat angle decide the skips with a little seeded wobble from the lake, and each friend's best stone floats as a buoy with their face.
useWhen: who can skip a rock the most times at lake wren
quick game for the lake day chat
settle the rock skipping argument from the trip
something to play while we wait for will to park the sube
lowkey bored, give the chat a little game
dontUseWhen: planning the lake day itself (use trip-lock or friends-plans)
a trivia or quiz game (use trivia-night or trip-quiz)

throws.description: Throws already made, one per friend: skips 0 to 15 and a line in their words
